gloss: club member; team member; department staff

definitions.gloss: club member; team member; department staff
definitions.explanation: A member of a {部|ぶ} — either a school/university club ({文化部|ぶんかぶ}, {運動部|うんどうぶ}) or, in a company, a member of a department ({営業部|えいぎょうぶ}, {人事部|じんじぶ}). Context determines which sense applies, but the school-club usage is by far the most common in everyday speech.

examples.japanese: テニス{部|ぶ}の{部員|ぶいん}を{募集|ぼしゅう}している。
examples.english: The tennis club is recruiting members.

examples.japanese: {新入|しんにゅう}の{部員|ぶいん}が{十人|じゅうにん}{入|はい}った。
examples.english: Ten new members joined the club.

examples.japanese: {部長|ぶちょう}は{部員|ぶいん}{全員|ぜんいん}の{意見|いけん}を{聞|き}いてから{方針|ほうしん}を{決|き}めた。
examples.english: The club president listened to all the members' opinions before deciding on a policy.

notes:
Compound of {部|ぶ} (club, department, division) + {員|いん} (member). The senior member who leads the {部|ぶ} is the {部長|ぶちょう}.

USAGE:
- School/university: {部員|ぶいん} = a member of a club such as {野球|やきゅう}{部|ぶ}, {吹奏楽|すいそうがく}{部|ぶ}, etc.
- Workplace: {部員|ぶいん} = a member of a department, e.g. {営業部|えいぎょうぶ}の{部員|ぶいん} (sales department staff)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {部員|ぶいん}を{募集|ぼしゅう}する: to recruit club members
- {新入|しんにゅう}{部員|ぶいん}: new club member
- {部員|ぶいん}{全員|ぜんいん}: all the members
- {部員|ぶいん}{数|すう}: number of members

SIMILAR / RELATED WORDS:
- メンバー: member — broader, casual; covers any kind of group
- {部長|ぶちょう}: club president / department head — leader of the {部|ぶ}
- {会員|かいいん}: member (of an association or organization) — used for {会|かい}, not {部|ぶ}
